chronology_note: r144 extends the zero-quota Git repository pattern from UTF-8 state to small raw binary writes and atomic multi-file publication. create_blob(base64)+tree+commit+force=false ref update materialized non-UTF-8 bytes and survived a live non-fast-forward conflict via fresh-parent reconstruction. A second binary fixture exposed a strict boundary: fetch_file(..., encoding=base64) is not generically byte-faithful even when it reports the correct blob SHA, and malformed base64 was accepted by create_blob. Therefore raw binary write/materialization passes in bounded scope, but arbitrary Chat-native binary readback remains unresolved. Next: read-only probe existing blob/file surfaces for byte-faithful base64 retrieval, then formalize the Git Data transaction capsule.
